## Problem

Describe the user goal or demonstrated failure.

## Change

Explain the smallest behavior or resource change that addresses it.

## Evidence

- [ ] Repository validation passes
- [ ] Public-content scan passes
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Direct, indirect, and negative routing cases were considered
- [ ] A realistic forward test was reviewed when behavior changed materially

## Boundaries

State what this change intentionally does not solve and whether it changes any human approval or external-action boundary.
